## Problem and approved workflow

When the user gives resource limits with `/goal` in an existing dev tab, the agent must register them through Codex Wake MCP. An independent enforcer observes time and cumulative tokens, requests "stop and checkpoint" before exhaustion, then pauses the native goal and interrupts its exact active turn if required. No tab/session migration or dedicated OS executor is required for this mode.

The operator confirmed: checkpoint reserve inside the original budget; default threshold when either 5% of tokens or60 seconds remain; cumulative objective accounting from original goal start including cached input and attributable delegated work; unknown accounting holds. Native control failure is unverified termination, not a process-stop guarantee.

## Acceptance

- Caller-authorized MCP enrollment and readback use host-controlled endpoint/home/root scope; callers cannot select peer goals or override host ceilings.
- An armed receipt proves durable watcher readiness and a qualified accounting baseline. First registration may enroll an already-active native goal without reading it from an unrelated new home.
- Original deadline and cumulative spend survive repeated registration, resume and controller restart; no automatic budget renewal.
- Exactly one attributable checkpoint request is persisted before delivery, carved from original caps; ambiguous delivery is reconciled rather than duplicated. Pause/interrupt still occurs at exhaustion or loss of qualified accounting.
- Pause targets the registered native goal and exact active turn; changed goal identity, uncertain effects and unavailable native control are reported truthfully. Shared servers and unrelated work are preserved.
- Cached-inclusive source/delegate usage is attributed once. Missing baseline, publication uncertainty, unsupported delegation and stale/malformed/decreasing counters fail closed rather than substitute native display counters.
- Public MCP/CLI and independent-process acceptance demonstrate the actual same-tab workflow; native and injected evidence remain distinct. Agent skill and tool catalog lead an ordinary agent through setup, status and limitations.

## Scope and coordination

Owner: ecochran76 / primary. State: IN_PROGRESS. Plan: docs/dev/plans/0167-2026-10-17-resource-enforcement-discoverability.md. Branch: feat/objective-enforcement (prior validated strict-executor component retained). Related #274/#278; this is existing-goal supervision, not a replacement for dedicated kernel containment. No merge, release, fleet rollout, shared-server termination or exact token-ceiling claim. Native/provider acceptance uses disposable qualified fixtures only.

Prior audit and agreed boundary: commit49a5260 and docs/adr/0001-existing-goal-supervision.md (design in progress).
